name: Tasha Williams

five_sec.what_is_it: An app that plans dinner and texts you about it
five_sec.trust_why: 90,000 families sounds like a lot, but the button is a CEO letter
five_sec.next_step: Scroll to see if Kroger is on there
five_sec.delivers_food_why: 'Tonight's dinner is a good one' sounds like it's showing up at my door

full_page.what_stopped_me: List goes to Instacart, Walmart or Amazon Fresh, no Kroger. The family group chat is on the $25 a month plan
full_page.whats_missing: Kroger, a price I can live with

OL.quote: Honestly the group chat idea is what I need on night shift, but it's $25 a month for that, and no Kroger.

five_sec.trust_why: Box game before they tell you anything

full_page.what_stopped_me: Did this with EveryPlate. 'Shipping fee applies on all deliveries after the first box,' price hidden behind a zip code, and the '10 free meals' is based on a 4-person plan

HF.quote: 'Shipping fee applies on all deliveries after the first box.' Been there with EveryPlate. Box for 4, five of us, everybody hungry.

five_sec.what_is_it: It texts the whole house the dinner ideas and puts the list in your cart
five_sec.who_for: Families like mine where not everybody's home
five_sec.trust_why: Says no card and that they don't deliver food; I need to see Kroger
five_sec.delivers_food_why: 'We don't deliver food' right under the paragraph

full_page.what_stopped_me: Kroger cart is only on Family. At least it says so up front, and $4.99 is fine if the whole house uses it. Sample week serves 4, we're 5. Mama's low-sodium isn't named; profiles say allergies and won't-eats
full_page.whats_missing: Low-sodium setting, a week for 5, what my husband sees on a cook night

DD.quote: 'Text reminders on your cook nights' and everybody gets the dinners by text? At the end of the day, that's my husband knowing what's for dinner when I'm on nights.

full_page.what_stopped_me: No price on the page, and nobody else in the house sees the plan unless they open the app

EM.quote: eMeals names Kroger, I'll give it that. But it's one more app only I look at, and I'm not home.

five_sec.trust_why: 4.8 stars and no card for the trial
five_sec.next_step: See if the family can share it
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's an app for recipes and lists

full_page.what_stopped_me: I'd have to put all the recipes in myself, then $5.95 a month
full_page.whats_missing: Dinner ideas and a way to reach my husband by text

PTE.quote: 'One account for the family' is nice, but my husband is not opening an app to read a calendar. He reads texts.

dd_offer.why: 14 days, no card, then $4.99 if I want to keep it
dd_offer.expect_day_15: The texting and the Kroger cart stop unless I put a card in, and I'm on the free version.

head_to_head.reason: The only one where the whole house gets the plan by text, and Kroger is there for $4.99

EM.reason: Everybody sees the plan, not just me

PTE.reason: Texts my husband can't ignore vs an app he won't open

HF.reason: Feeds 5 from my own Kroger, no shipping

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page Family section: show a week for 5 and say whether a person's profile can be set low-sodium, plus a screenshot of the cook-night text my husband would get.
